stem.text: The siren of a moving police car emits a sound wave with a frequency of $440\,\text{Hz}$. A stationary observer hears sound of frequency $494\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of sound in the air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What could be the speed and the direction of movement of the car?

B.text: $37\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ directly away from the observer

D.text: $42\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ directly away from the observer
